page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m1.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores with a single thread per core configuration. The instance is equipped with 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per core.

This instance does not include bundled local storage or integrated GPU hardware, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included with the default configuration.

With a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.m1.medium is positioned as a general-purpose resource. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource sharing, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for workloads requiring stable baseline compute. It is suited for general-purpose applications, web serving, and moderate database hosting where local high-speed storage or GPU acceleration is not required.
